first_order_optimizer_aggregate.description: Aggregate comparison from Table 1 over the paper's 61 imperfect-recall benchmark instances. Wall-clock time is not scored; convergence is measured by reach rate and iteration-rank style aggregates.

value_percent_best.description: Fraction of benchmark instances where the selected run attains the best final utility among the compared optimizers.

value_avg_rank.description: Average rank by selected-run final utility across instances, with lower rank indicating better utility.

value_avg_gap_to_best.description: Mean utility shortfall from the best selected run on the same instance, providing a continuous check beyond win counts.

convergence_percent_reached.description: Fraction of instances where the selected run reaches the fixed KKT-gap convergence threshold.

convergence_percent_best.description: Fraction of instances where the selected run reaches the convergence threshold in the fewest iterations among compared optimizers.

convergence_avg_rank.description: Average rank by selected-run iterations to reach the KKT-gap threshold, with nonconverged runs ranked last.

selected_iterations_to_gap_mean.description: Diagnostic raw mean selected-run iteration count to reach the KKT-gap threshold, using a one-step-over-budget penalty for nonconvergence.

selected_log10_iterations_to_gap_mean.description: Mean base-10 log selected-run iteration count to reach the KKT-gap threshold, using a one-step-over-budget penalty for nonconvergence. This scores convergence effort on a multiplicative scale.

selected_log10_kkt_gap_mean.description: Mean base-10 log final KKT gap for selected runs, retaining signal when binary convergence metrics saturate.

restart_convergence_percent.description: Fraction of all recorded random restarts that reach the KKT-gap threshold, discouraging cherry-picked selected runs.
